# telnyx_phone_number_voicemail (Resource)

The voicemail of a phone number. Destroy removes it from Terraform state only.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `phone_number_id` (String) The phone number id.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether voicemail is enabled.
- `greeting` (Attributes) Controls the greeting a caller hears before leaving a voicemail. Set `mode` to `default` to play the standard system greeting, or to `custom_greeting` to play your own audio. When `mode` is `custom_greeting`, `media_name` is required and must reference an audio file already uploaded to your account through the Media Storage API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--greeting))
- `pin` (String, Sensitive) The pin used for the voicemail.

<a id="nestedatt--greeting"></a>
### Nested Schema for `greeting`

Optional:

- `media_name` (String) The name of the media file to play as the greeting. Required when `mode` is `custom_greeting`; ignored when `mode` is `default`. The value must match the `media_name` of a file you previously uploaded with the Media Storage API (`POST /v2/media`).
- `mode` (String) The greeting mode. `default` plays the standard system greeting. `custom_greeting` plays the audio referenced by `media_name`. One of `custom_greeting`, `default`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_phone_number_voicemail.example <phone_number_id>
```
